name: Brand new user
query: Ich bin neu bei FiBuKI, richte mich bitte ein.
expected_behavior: Calls get_onboarding_status (with its own origin) and get_automation_status, and does not interview the user first
Shows one short checklist from the status: Identität, Postfach, Bankkonto, Import, erste Belege, with what is done and what is next
Starts with the identity step and explains in one line that otherwise the user's own issued invoices would be matched to their expenses
Asks for name, UID, own IBANs, other names and address, shows exactly what it will save, and only then calls create_identity_entity
Calls get_onboarding_status again afterwards and reports the identity step as done

Explains the Postfach choice once: FiBuKI's own (recommended, keeps syncing in the background) or the assistant's connected mailbox during a session, and leaves the choice to the user; if they pick the assistant's mail, skips connect_email with skip_onboarding_step
Does not claim to know whether a Postfach is connected (no tool lists them) and asks instead
success_criteria: Identity is the first step worked on
create_identity_entity is not called before the user confirmed the values
No step is skipped without the user's say-so
Ends with a three-line status and the sentence to continue
